subject: Pen test scope, firm credentials, cadence and report validity for SOC 2
messages:
From: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@datasecure.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-02T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: Inquiry: penetration test report validity & firm creds for SOC2

Hi Mina / Karthik,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 Type II evidence collection and had a couple of quick questions about Redwood's most recent penetration test. Can you confirm: 

- Which third-party firm performed the last full pen test and the engagement date?
- Do you provide the full report under NDA and an executive summary for auditors?
- For SOC 2 auditors we typically need test date to be within 12 months of the report period — is Redwood's latest test within that window?
- Do you offer remediation retest (re‑scan or validation) and what's the typical timing/cost?

If possible, please include the testing methodology/certifications (OWASP, NIST SP 800-115, CREST/ISO) and a contact at the testing firm. Thanks — we need to nail this down before our control testing begins in early December.

Best,
Emma Thomas
Security & Compliance Manager
DataSecure Labs
emma.thomas@datasecure.com

[Attachment: none at this time]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@datasecure.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-03T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: penetration test report validity & firm creds for SOC2

Hi Emma — thanks for the note. Quick answers up front, details below.

- Firm: TrustedPen LLC (engagement ID: TP-2025-044). Test date: 2025-09-18 — so within the 12-month window for your December control testing.
- Deliverables: we publish a high-level executive summary publicly; the full technical report is available under NDA.
- Methodology: tests follow an internal scoping doc built on OWASP Top 10, plus NIST SP 800-115 techniques for exploitation and validation. TrustedPen holds CREST equivalency and ISO 27001 for their testing practice.
- Retest: we include one remediation validation (retest) within 30 days of receiving remediation evidence at no additional charge; beyond that we schedule a paid re-assessment.

Attached is a short slide that outlines the standard scope and typical deliverables (external app, authenticated web app testing, cloud infra reconnaissance). If you want code review or source-assisted testing, that is scoped separately and we can include it in the SOW.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm the exact scope you need (external only vs auth + infra + code).
2) Sign the NDA (we'll share the TrustedPen contact and release the full report).
3) If you want SOW + schedule, Karthik can push a SOW and coordinate procurement.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Mina Haddad
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
[Attachment: ppt-pen-test-scope-2024.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

From: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@datasecure.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-05T09:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: penetration test report validity & firm creds for SOC2

Mina — this is helpful, thanks. A couple follow-ups from our side so we can confirm scope with auditors:

- Scope ask: we need external network + authenticated web application testing, and confirmation that cloud control plane (IAM configs, S3 buckets, GCP/AWS IAM) were reviewed. Does TrustedPen include cloud infra checks as part of your standard external + authenticated scope or is that add-on?
- Methodology detail: can you confirm whether TrustedPen uses manual verification of findings vs fully automated scanners (we need evidence of manual verification for medium/high findings).
- Firm creds: can you share a short credentials pack (CREST/ISO certs, a couple of tester CVs or bios)? Our procurement team will require that.

Also, please confirm: is the 30-day remediation retest a full re-assessment or a targeted validation of remediated findings? And is there a standard SOW template we can review?

Thanks — if easier we can take these items in a call; otherwise a short reply and attachments will do.

-Emma

[Attachment: none]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@datasecure.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: penetration test report validity & firm creds for SOC2

Emma — looping in Grace from Customer Success to coordinate procurement timing. Mina's points are accurate; answering your bullets at high level and proposing a schedule: 

- Cloud infra: TrustedPen does include cloud control plane checks as an optional module. For your requirements we recommend the AUTH+INFRA bundle.
- Manual verification: TrustedPen performs manual verification for all medium+ findings and includes proof-of-concept steps in the technical appendix.
- Credentials pack & SOW: attaching a draft SOW and the standard procurement checklist. If that looks OK we'll route a short NDA and then TrustedPen will share the full report and tester CVs.

Proposed schedule if you confirm scope this week:
- NDA executed: by 2025-11-14
- Release report + credentials under NDA: 1 business day after NDA
- Remediation window: 30 days (free retest validation within this window)

Attachment: redwood-sow-pt-2025.docx (SOW, 2 pages)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min sync with your audit team.

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-sow-pt-2025.docx (DOCX, 98KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@datasecure.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-12T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: penetration test report validity & firm creds for SOC2

Emma / team — finalizing answers and next steps below.

Scope: we'll proceed with External + Authenticated Web App + Cloud Infra module (includes IAM & storage config review). Code review is out-of-scope for this engagement unless you request source-assisted testing; we can add that to the SOW if needed.

Methodology / validation: TrustedPen uses a hybrid approach — automated reconnaissance to build coverage, followed by manual exploit/verification for medium and high severity items. Their deliverable includes:
- Executive summary (suitable for auditors)
- Full technical report with PoCs and remediation guidance
- Appendix listing test cases and evidence screenshots/commands

Remediation retest: the included retest is a targeted validation of remediated findings (we do not re-run every test end-to-end). If you prefer a full re-assessment we can schedule that as a paid engagement.

Firm credentials: attaching the TrustedPen short pack (certs + bios). TrustedPen has CREST-equivalent accreditation and ISO 27001 for their security practice. Contact at TrustedPen: ops@trustedpen.com (attn: Jonathan Reed).

Report validity: for SOC2 evidence we consider the pen test valid for 12 months from the test date. Our last test (TP-2025-044) was 2025-09-18, so it covers control testing through 2026-09-17. If your audit period extends beyond that, we can schedule a focused re-test earlier.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Approve the attached SOW and scope (External + Auth + Cloud Infra).
2) Sign the NDA (we can send DocuSign).
3) We will request TrustedPen to release the full report once NDA is returned.

Attachments included: trustedpen-credentials.pdf (PDF, 210KB); redwood-pt-executive-summary-2025.pdf (PDF, 95KB).

If you'd like a short call to walk through the report content, Karthik / Grace and I are available next week.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
[Attachments: trustedpen-credentials.pdf, redwood-pt-executive-summary-2025.pdf]
